Solved: Top 10 Methods to Fix JSONDecodeError Expecting Value

Are you struggling with the dreaded JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0) in your Python applications? This error often arises when working with JSON data, particularly during API calls. It’s critical to comprehend why this happens and explore various methods to resolve this error efficiently.

Understanding the Issue

This error typically indicates that the JSON parser received an empty response or improperly formatted data. Here is a scenario that illustrates this problem: you might be able to access the API endpoint in your browser, but when you try to fetch the same data using a Python script with a cURL request, you face the JSON decoding error.
